verdict.rationale: Mintlify's own custom-domain docs say you can host your site at your own domain, subdomain, or subpath, with DNS records, automatic TLS, and either Mintlify-managed or proxy routing. The pricing page lists custom domain as a platform feature. This covers both halves of the story, but only through summary-level first-party claims. Missing for 10: detailed setup documentation for /docs subpath proxy configuration (e.g., per-provider steps or limits), independent or hands-on corroboration that subpath hosting works as described.

support.subject: As a DevRel lead, I serve docs on my own custom domain or as a /docs subpath of my main site

citations.quote: Host your site at your own domain, subdomain, or subpath with DNS records, automatic TLS certificates, and Mintlify-managed or proxy traffic routing.
